notices.short_title: Rules Prohibiting Sale of Dogs, Cats and Rabbits by Pet Shops
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene published a notice of rules that would prohibit pet shops from selling dogs, cats and rabbits.

notices.short_title: NOTICE OF ADOPTION OF EMERGENCY RULE REPEALING THE LOW BARRIER BED PLACEMENT PROCESS RULE
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services adopted an emergency rule, published Feb. 17, 2026, that repeals its rule on the low barrier bed placement process.

The Department for the Aging awarded D Exposito & Partners LLC a $200,000 contract for caregiver campaign creative development services through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business, without competition.

notices.short_title: FY 26 Lenovo Patch Component Continuation of Services
notices.plain: The city comptroller's office awarded Y and S Technologies, Inc. a $21,403 contract for Lenovo patch components, a small purchase made without competition from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.short_title: Senior Data Analyst consultant for NYCERS LRP project
notices.vendor_name: Integrated Technology Solutions and Services Inc. (ITSSI)
notices.plain: The Employees' Retirement System awarded Integrated Technology Solutions and Services Inc. (ITSSI) a $215,064 contract for a senior data analyst consultant on its NYCERS LRP project, through a government-to-government purchase.
The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking bids for tug and towing services for its Marine Section, with responses due March 11, 2026, and the lowest qualified bid will win.
The Department of Environmental Protection awarded Itineris NA, Inc. a $99,760 sole-source contract for ServiceLink software licenses, with only one vendor considered.

notices.short_title: 81626Y0792-Sole Source with Hologic Sales and Service LLC
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene intends to award a sole-source goods contract to Hologic Sales and Service LLC, with responses due Feb. 27, 2026.

notices.short_title: FY27 Renewal - FWC Shelter at Prospect Family (88 units)
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services intends to renew a contract for shelter services at Prospect Family, with 88 units, for fiscal year 2027, with responses due Feb. 18, 2026.

notices.short_title: Correction: 33202104; Elevator Modernization at Elmhurst Hospital Cars 6, 7, 10, Annex O & G
notices.plain: NYC Health + Hospitals is seeking bids, due April 8, 2026, for a corrected solicitation to modernize elevators at Elmhurst Hospital, including cars 6, 7 and 10 and Annexes O and G, with the lowest qualified bid to win.
The Police Department intends to award a contract for examination kits, a goods purchase, with responses to a Request for Information due Feb. 27, 2026.

notices.short_title: Brooklyn South Industrial Business Zone Negotiated Acquisition Extension Contract
notices.plain: The Department of Small Business Services intends to extend a services contract for the Brooklyn South Industrial Business Zone through a negotiated acquisition, with responses due Feb. 25, 2026.

The Department of Transportation awarded DTM Parts Supply Inc a $100,000 contract for air starter parts and accessories through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business made without competition.

The Department of Transportation awarded Portland Williams LLC a $70,000 contract for hand squeeze roller applicators, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

The Department of Citywide Administrative Services published a notice on Feb. 17, 2026, about overhead door repair work for certified minority- and women-owned businesses, and gave no vendor, dollar amount or deadline.
The city comptroller's office has published a notice on Feb. 17, 2026, about a real estate investment consultant agreement open for public comment.

notices.short_title: NEWMOBIL, Purchase of a new Mobile Food Pantry Unit
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction is seeking public comment on a proposed purchase of a new mobile food pantry unit from NEWMOBIL, according to a notice published Feb. 17, 2026.

notices.short_title: 1625-TDR Removal, Transportation and Disposal of Residuals from The Wards Island Transfer Facility
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection published a notice on Feb. 17, 2026, inviting public comment on the proposed award of a contract for removing, transporting and disposing of residuals from the Wards Island Transfer Facility.

notices.short_title: SHELTER FACILITIES FOR HOMELESS SINGLE ADULTS
SHELTER FACILITIES FOR HOMELESS FAMILIES WITH CHILDREN
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services published a notice on Feb. 17, 2026, inviting public comment on contract awards for shelter facilities for homeless families with children, without listing a vendor, dollar amount or deadline.
The Department of Transportation is seeking public comment on a contract award for an enterprise systems developer.

notices.short_title: Queens Borough President Budget Hearing on Fiscal Year 2027 Preliminary Expense and Capital Budgets
notices.plain: The Queens Borough President's office will hold a public hearing on Feb. 24, 2026, on its preliminary expense and capital budgets for fiscal year 2027.

notices.short_title: Notice of Business Integrity Commission Meeting on February 24, 2026.
notices.plain: The Business Integrity Commission will hold a public meeting on Feb. 24, 2026, as announced in this notice published Feb. 17, 2026.

notices.short_title: Public hearing in the matter of the direct sale of properties located in the borough of Brooklyn.
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services will hold a public hearing on March 25, 2026, about the proposed direct sale of properties in Brooklyn.
The Department of Transportation will hold a public hearing on its Dining Out NYC program on March 12, 2026.
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development is asking for public comment on a list of single-room occupancy buildings, according to a notice published Feb. 17, 2026.
The Mayor's Office of Contract Services published a Special Materials notice titled "LL63/SBS/NEW" on Feb. 17, 2026, but the title is the only detail it gives.
The Mayor's Office of Environmental Coordination published a notice titled "CEQR Projects" on Feb. 17, 2026, in the Special Materials section, but the title is the only description it gives.
The Office of Collective Bargaining has proposed recognizing a union under case VR-1733-26, according to a notice published Feb. 17, 2026.
